findings.finding:
Use tournament tree: each node of size 2m splits into left/right halves; winners set must be a Dyck word ⇒ Cₘ choices (Catalan).  
N=∏_{k=0}^{19}(C_{2^k})^{2^{19‑k}}.  
Compute v₂(N)=∑2^{19‑k}·v₂(C_{2^k}), v₅ similarly.  
v₂(N)=524 287, v₅(N)=121 818 ⇒k=min=121 818.  
Answer k mod 10⁵ = 21 818.  
Pitfall: ensure Catalan count (Dyck condition) and independence of nodes.
